approaches.name: digital case management and CRM for commercial justice and investment promotion
approaches.description: The project finances digital case management for commercial courts and a full CRM for investment promotion and investor aftercare services. Practices: Digital case management for commercial justice; Full CRM system for investment promotion and investor aftercare.
approaches.why_innovative: New process: digital case management in commercial courts - cue: 'digitization of' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: Examples include support for the digitization of case management to streamline commercial justice.

extra_evidence.text: The project will develop and utilize digital solutions for government to business services (G2B) to facilitate activities for the private sector.
The project will support the implementation of a full CRM system for the various services of EDBM, including the investment promotion activities.

Such system will strengthen EDBM’s ability to track the investor services they provide (from first contacts, to lead to projects, to issues, reinvestment and linkages), thereby improving the quality of these services.
As part of the current investment retention program, a relationship management system using a free platform (Hubspot) has been put into place as a transitional solution.
